COMMS 500: This course is designed to provide students a broad background in communications and cultural theory.
COMMS 503: This course prepares students to conduct research in communications using both qualitative and quantitative research methods.
COMMS 519: An advanced study of various interpretive approaches and methodological tools that are central to the analysis of cultural artifacts.
COMMS 525: This course supports the development of advanced writing projects in a range of different genres.
COMMS 555: This course provides students with advanced theoretical approaches and methodological tools to analyze a variety of media discourses.
COMMS 560: This course explores the globalization of communication and communication technologies within a broad political, economic and cultural context.
COMMS 568: This course prepares students for the creation of advanced media projects in traditional and digital media.
COMMS 580: An original master's paper or creative production with critical paper.
